project.name: EIR :: persistence
project.description:
The schema of 04, as executable PostgreSQL 16 DDL under src/main/resources/db/migration, plus a framework-free constants layer naming the tables and columns the engine reads.
Deliberately carries NO compile dependency — not JPA, not Flyway, not a driver. The root enforcer bans jakarta.persistence, Hibernate, Spring and Jackson across every module, so wiring an ORM here would require restructuring that ban: a shared root-pom edit, and one that deserves its own change rather than riding along with the schema. The migrations are numbered in Flyway's convention so that wiring is a later addition and not a rewrite.
The DDL is verified by execution against a real PostgreSQL 16 cluster, not by review — see the module README.
